_meta.purpose: Cost + walk table for planner/expand-goals.mjs. Maps a goal's unit type to metal/energy/build-work and gives each builder its build power, move speed, and build range.
_meta.buildWork: Build work in buildpower-seconds (BAR units/*.lua `buildTime`). Wall-clock build_time_s = buildWork / builderBuildPower, so the same building takes longer when a weaker builder makes it.
_meta.elmosPerGridSquareNote: = commander build range (145) / 3 squares. From bar-calc/eco-calculator-suite/bar_distance.py — the one tunable map-calibration assumption.

sources.bar-calc: Transcribed from splendid_baralytics/bar-calc/bar_unified.py (building costs) and eco-calculator-suite/bar_distance.py (builder speed/range/build-power). These are flagged `_source` and treated as canonical.
sources.PROVISIONAL: Entries with `_PROVISIONAL: true` are NOT in bar-calc (it only tables buildings, not bot units or the T2 lab). Numbers are placeholders; the canonical value must be pulled from the named `_canonical` BAR unit def. Do not trust these for projection.

_builderResolution: Actor 'com'/'commander' -> commander profile. Every other actor (workers, con bots, laz, give/reclaim units, and the unassigned 'pool:any') -> con profile. pool:any is the placeholder for a build whose `who` the intent left open; the expander defaults it to a con and flags nothing, but the projection step should re-resolve it once site/actor assignment is real.

wind._note: energyIncome is wind-condition dependent; 10 = all-that-glitters average. The intent's `conditional` carries the substitution rule.

con._note: maps to eco_engine 'worker' key; gives {builderBp:80, ePerSec:7} on completion

laz._note: not in bar-calc or eco_engine; no income effect on completion

t2lab._note: not in bar-calc; adds 200 BP builder on completion

units._legion_section: Legion unit costs from gex_research/legion/legion_unitdefs.json. Use leg_* names in Legion intent files so ARM tests are unaffected.

leg_medmex._note: upgrades legmex slot: ΔM ≈+2.28 m/s net, ΔE = −37 E/s swing. Proxied as mex:1 in eco_engine (ARM rate); build timing model is accurate.

leg_turret._note: maps to eco_engine 'conTurret' (costs already match); gives {builderBp:200}

leg_estor._note: maps to eco_engine 'eStorage' gives {storE:6000}; costs differ from eco_engine's ARM eStorage entry

leg_t2factory._note: T2 bot lab; FACTORY_BUILDERS adds 600 BP in project.mjs

leg_t2con._note: T2 con bot; UNITS_EXT gives {builderBp:195, ePerSec:14}
